purpose: Provider-neutral canonical operating context for Orchid Continuum autonomous engineering.

memory_layers.canonical: Small durable operating truths loaded every run.
memory_layers.retrievable: Detailed architecture, decisions, failures, and knowledge objects fetched on demand.
memory_layers.episodic: Run receipts, failures, retries, test evidence, and merge outcomes.

evaluation.success_definition: Ten consecutive autonomous loops without an unhandled blockage, silent refusal, duplicate lease, unsafe merge, or missing completion evidence.
